{{Expand Polish|date=August 2026|topic=hist}}
'''Brunon Leszek Kwiecień''' (21 June{{Citation needed|date=October 2026}} 1967 – 6 August 2019) was a Polish chemist and university lecturer who became the first person in the Third Polish Republic to be convicted of terrorism. A doctor of chemistry and former employee of the [[Agricultural University of Kraków]], Kwiecień,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Nowa Nauka Polska |url=https://archiwum.nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=99468 |access-date=2026-08-23 |website=archiwum.nauka-polska.pl}}</ref> Kwiecień was arrested in 2012 for planning a terrorist attack on [[Sejm]], the Polish parliament, using a [[car bomb]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2015-12-21 |title=Wyrok w sprawie przygotowania zamachu na Sejm: Brunon Kwiecień skazany na 13 lat więzienia |url=https://wiadomosci.dziennik.pl/wydarzenia/artykuly/508750,jest-wyrok-w-sprawie-brunona-kwietnia-mezczyzna-skazany-na-13-lat-wiezienia.html |access-date=2026-08-23 |website=Dziennik.pl |language=pl}}</ref>

== Career ==
In 1982, at the age of 15, he caused an explosion of an amateur pyrotechnic mixture in his own home, which damaged his hands, depriving them of several fingers, and led to damage to his eyesight.<ref name=":1">{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AB8qgSFaHdk |title=Brunon Kwiecień: byłem namawiany, żeby werbować ludzi do zamachu (UWAGA! TVN) |date=2017-04-21 |last=Uwaga! TVN |access-date=2026-08-23 |via=YouTube}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Szulc |first=Anna |date=2012-11-28 |title=Nie żyje Brunon Kwiecień, który w 2012 r. chciał wysadzić w powietrze Sejm |url=https://www.newsweek.pl/polska/brunon-kwiecien-nie-zyje-kim-byl-czlowiek-ktory-chcial-wysadzic-sejm/sxzmmny |access-date=2026-08-23 |website=Newsweek |language=pl}}</ref>

He graduated from the Chemical Technical School in Kraków and then from chemical technology at the [[Tadeusz Kościuszko Kraków University of Technology]].<ref>{{Cite news |title=Brunon K. - kim jest człowiek, który planował zamach na władze Polski |url=http://wiadomosci.gazeta.pl/wiadomosci/1,114873,12888740,Brunon_K____kim_jest_czlowiek__ktory_planowal_zamach.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191118192015/http://wiadomosci.gazeta.pl/wiadomosci/1,114873,12888740,Brunon_K____kim_jest_czlowiek__ktory_planowal_zamach.html |archive-date=2019-11-18 |access-date=2026-08-23 |work=gazetapl |language=pl-PL}}</ref> On 16 May 1996, he began his doctoral studies, and on 27 November 2000, he obtained his doctorate at the Institute of Organic Chemistry of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]], based on his doctoral thesis entitled "Selected issues of spectroscopy and applications in the synthesis of β-sulfonylenamine".<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Nowa Nauka Polska |url=https://archiwum.nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/research?id=93478 |access-date=2026-08-23 |website=archiwum.nauka-polska.pl}}</ref> The thesis supervisor was professor Lech Jan Kozerski.<ref name=":0" /> He obtained a PhD in chemical sciences in chemistry, specializing in organic chemistry.<ref name=":0" /> In November 2012, he joined the [[National Rebirth of Poland]], an [[far-right politics|far-right]] political party.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Brunon Kwiecień – obecny! |url=https://www.nop.org.pl/2020/08/06/brunon-kwiecien-obecny/ |access-date=2026-08-23 |website=Narodowe Odrodzenie Polski (NOP) – Nacjonalistyczna Opozycja}}</ref>

== Accusation and trial for preparing an attack ==
He was accused of preparing an attack between July and November 2012, which was to be carried out at the [[Sejm]] of the Republic of Poland, where a budget session took place when high-ranking state authorities, including then-President [[Bronisław Komorowski]] and Prime Minister [[Donald Tusk]], were in attendance.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Proces Brunona Kwietnia. Rozprawa w tajnej sali Sądu Najwyższego |url=https://www.polskieradio.pl/13/3/Artykul/1359995,Proces-Brunona-Kwietnia-Rozprawa-w-tajnej-sali-Sadu-Najwyzszego |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231120213407/https://www.polskieradio.pl/13/3/Artykul/1359995,Proces-Brunona-Kwietnia-Rozprawa-w-tajnej-sali-Sadu-Najwyzszego |archive-date=2023-11-20 |access-date=2026-08-23 |work=PolskieRadio.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref> The attack was to be carried out using a modified SKOT [[armoured personnel carrier]] (its sides were to be weakened by appropriate cuts, which would cause the energy of the explosion to spread more along its sides rather than upwards), in which four tonnes of [[potassium nitrate]]-based explosives were to be placed. He had recruited four other people for his cause, however they were actually [[Internal Security Agency]] (ABW) agents and one secret service collaborator.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Wyborcza.pl |url=https://wyborcza.pl/7,75398,15992919,sejmowy-terrorysta-wycofal-sie-z-zamachu-zatrzymano-go-i.html |access-date=2026-08-23 |website=wyborcza.pl}}</ref> During the investigation, the 35 weapons he was accused of possessing, the armored personnel carrier, and the explosives allegedly used in the attack were not found.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2014-05-20 |title=Zamach, którego miało nie być. Brunon Kwiecień odwołał atak na Sejm miesiąc przed zatrzymaniem, ABW nie znalazła broni |url=https://natemat.pl/102895,zamach-ktorego-mialo-nie-byc-brunon-kwiecien-odwolal-atak-na-sejm-miesiac-przed-zatrzymaniem-abw-nie-znalazla-broni |access-date=2026-08-23 |website=naTemat.pl |language=pl-pl}}</ref> However, approximately half a kilogram of explosives, including [[RDX|hexagon]], was found.

Kwiecień tried to arm himself in 1997, however the authorities refused his application for a firearm permit. He later started arming himself illegally, mostly with weapons bought in Belgium.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Chemik zafascynowany Breivikiem |url=http://www.rp.pl/artykul/10,953875-Chemik-zafascynowany-Breivikiem.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150428025707/http://www.rp.pl/artykul/10,953875-Chemik-zafascynowany-Breivikiem.html |archive-date=2015-04-28 |access-date=2026-08-23 |work=Rzeczpospolita}}</ref>

Kwiecień was an admirer of [[Anders Behring Breivik]], the perpetrator of the [[2011 Norway attacks]], and was further inspired by the 1995 [[Oklahoma City bombing]].<ref name="pol copy 1">{{Cite news |url=http://zpravy.idnes.cz/polsko-zmarilo-chystany-teroristicky-utok-na-predstavitele-zeme-1cz-/zahranicni.aspx?c=A121120_081639_zahranicni_js |title=Polsko zmařilo atentát na Sejm. Vědec chtěl odpálit 4 tuny výbušnin [Poland foiled an attack against the Sejm. A scientist wanted to detonate 4 tonnes of explosives] |journal=[[Mladá fronta Dnes]] |date=20 November 2012 |access-date=24 November 2012  |language=cs}}</ref><ref name="pol copy 7">{{Cite journal |last=West |first=Ben |date=29 November 2012 |title=Mimicking Breivik in Poland |url=http://www.stratfor.com/weekly/mimicking-breivik-poland |journal=[[Stratfor]] |language=en |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121202012104/http://www.stratfor.com/weekly/mimicking-breivik-poland |archive-date=2 December 2012 |access-date=2 December 2012}}</ref> Internal Security Agency first found out about Kwiecień after it launched investigation into Breivik's Polish contacts when it became known that Breivik had ordered some of the chemicals for his bomb from Poland via the internet. According to ABW, Kwiecień was preparing an attack against the Sejm.<ref name="pol copy 2">{{Cite news |url=http://www.wprost.pl/ar/357276/Niedoszly-zamachowiec-wpadl-przez-Breivika/?pg=0 |title=Niedoszły zamachowiec wpadł przez Breivika |publisher= |date=20 November 2012 |access-date=24 November 2012 | language=pl|work=[[wprost.pl]]|trans-title=Failed attacker was caught thanks to Breivik}}</ref> According to Kwiecień's account, it was prepared specifically at the request of ABW agents to blow up the Jewish martyrdom monument in Białystok. Furthermore, some witnesses who were Kwiecień's acquaintances spoke of his belief in an impending revolution in Poland and that the government should be overthrown by force.<ref name=":1" /> Apart from targeting the parliament, Kwiecień was also preparing murders of [[Monika Olejnik]], an influential journalist, and [[Hanna Gronkiewicz-Waltz]], the mayor of Warsaw.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Wyborcza.pl |url=https://wyborcza.pl/7,75398,12936571,monika-olejnik-i-hanna-gronkiewicz-waltz-na-celowniku-brunona.html |access-date=2026-08-23 |website=wyborcza.pl}}</ref>

Kwiecień himself vehemently denied engaging in any activities aimed at committing such a crime. He further claimed that he had been incited to do so by third parties, disguised agents of the secret services, without himself having initiated them. After their suggestions regarding the recruitment of other members of the terrorist organization, he allegedly agreed to invite two of the most active students from his explosives lectures to participate in the project, but they steadfastly refused. He was then contacted by members of the far-right organization [[Blood & Honour]], who were allegedly interested in organizing an attack. Kwiecień's role was supposedly limited to conducting theoretical lectures on explosives. He emphasized that he refused to conduct practical lectures, as he did not have a permit or license for such attempts, but agreed to prepare the group for the attack. The preparations were to include familiarizing them with the use of explosives, the production of explosive mixtures, and the arming and detonation of explosives. At some point he tried to withdraw from it, suspecting that he was involved in an operational game.<ref name=":1" />

In 2012, the body of his murdered mother-in-law was found in a forest, approximately 30 km from his home. Her blood was found, among other things, in Kwiecień's car and at her home. He claimed during the investigation that he was only questioned as a witness, and the blood found was the result of his mother-in-law's frequent nosebleeds or an accidental injury while cleaning his car.<ref name=":1" />

===Trial and death===
[[File:Grób Brunona Kwietnia.jpg|thumb|The grave of Brunon Kwiecień at the Prądnik Czerwony Cemetery]]
He was arrested on 9 November 2012<ref>{{Cite news |title=Grozi mu piętnaście lat więzienia |url=https://www.tvp.info/11817108/brunon-k-z-zarzutami-o-terroryzm |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231121163905/https://www.tvp.info/11817108/brunon-k-z-zarzutami-o-terroryzm |archive-date=2023-11-21 |access-date=2026-08-23 |language=pl}}</ref> and the trial began on 28 January 2014.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Redakcja |date=2014-01-28 |title=Przed krakowskim sądem odbyła się pierwsza rozprawa Brunona Kwietnia [ZDJĘCIA] |url=https://gazetakrakowska.pl/przed-krakowskim-sadem-odbyla-sie-pierwsza-rozprawa-brunona-kwietnia-zdjecia/ar/3314100 |access-date=2026-08-23 |website=Gazeta Krakowska |language=pl-PL}}</ref> On 21 December 2015, the District Court in Kraków sentenced Kwiecień to 13 years' imprisonment.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Redakcja |date=2014-01-28 |title=Przed krakowskim sądem odbyła się pierwsza rozprawa Brunona Kwietnia [ZDJĘCIA] |url=https://gazetakrakowska.pl/przed-krakowskim-sadem-odbyla-sie-pierwsza-rozprawa-brunona-kwietnia-zdjecia/ar/3314100 |access-date=2026-08-23 |website=Gazeta Krakowska |language=pl-PL}}</ref> In early April 2017, he was questioned by the prosecutor's office as a witness in the case of the [[murder of Katarzyna Zowada]] in 1998. The questioning concerned his acquaintance with one of the suspects, a researcher at the [[Jagiellonian University Medical College]].<ref name=":1" /> As a result of an appeal, on 19 April 2017, the court issued a judgment in which it reduced the absolute prison sentence to 9 years.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2014-12-12 |title=Brunon K. z mniejszym wymiarem kary {{!}} Niezalezna.pl |url=https://niezalezna.pl/polska/97364-brunon-k-z-mniejszym-wymiarem-kary/97364 |access-date=2026-08-23 |website=niezalezna.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref> On 19 April 2018, the [[Supreme Court of Poland]] dismissed the cassation appeal.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sąd Najwyższy oddalił trzy kasacje ws. Brunona Kwietnia |url=https://www.rp.pl/prawo-karne/art2000461-sad-najwyzszy-oddalil-trzy-kasacje-ws-brunona-kwietnia |access-date=2026-08-23 |website=Rzeczpospolita |language=pl}}</ref> The long duration of the trial, during which Kwiecień was held in [[pre-trial detention]], as well as the manner of conducting the investigation, were the subject of controversy in the media.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Jest apelacja ws. Brunona Kwietnia. Niedoszły zamachowiec został skazany na 13 lat więzienia |url=https://wpolityce.pl/spoleczenstwo/277525-jest-apelacja-ws-brunona-kwietnia-niedoszly-zamachowiec-zostal-skazany-na-13-lat-wiezienia |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241225092013/https://wpolityce.pl/spoleczenstwo/277525-jest-apelacja-ws-brunona-kwietnia-niedoszly-zamachowiec-zostal-skazany-na-13-lat-wiezienia |archive-date=2024-12-25 |access-date=2026-08-23 |language=pl}}</ref>

He was imprisoned in Wrocław Prison No. 1, where he died on 6 August 2019. An autopsy determined the cause to be a subarachnoid [[intracranial hemorrhage]] resulting from natural disease causes.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-08-08 |title=Brunon Kwiecień znaleziony martwy w celi. Śledczy mają już wyniki sekcji zwłok |url=https://wiadomosci.dziennik.pl/wydarzenia/artykuly/604500,brunon-kwiecien-zamach-sejm-smierc.html |access-date=2026-08-23 |website=Dziennik.pl |language=pl}}</ref> He was buried at the Prądnik Czerwony Cemetery.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Lokalizator Grobów - Zarząd Cmentarzy Komunalnych |url=https://zck-krakow.pl/locator/12?name=Brunon&sname=Kwiecie%C5%84&dyear=2019 |access-date=2026-08-23 |website=zck-krakow.pl}}</ref>

==Personal life==

Kwiecień was married and had two sons.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Wyborcza.pl |url=https://wyborcza.pl/7,87648,15985924,terror-po-polsku-brunon-kwiecien-kryptonim-doktor.html |access-date=2026-08-23 |website=wyborcza.pl}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2017-06-07 |title=Brunon Kwiecień: nie płakałbym po zamachu |url=https://wiadomosci.onet.pl/tylko-w-onecie/brunon-kwiecien-nie-plakalbym-po-zamachu/s6yf86n |access-date=2026-08-23 |website=wiadomosci.onet.pl |language=pl}}</ref>
